title: geum longifolium
intro: Geum longifolium, commonly known as Long-leaved Avens, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Geum longifolium include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of Geum longifolium for medicinal purposes.
